sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. State the principle of moments. (2 marks)
2. A force of 20 N acts on a body of mass 5 kg. Calculate the acceleration produced. (3 marks)
3. Using the circuit diagram, calculate the total resistance of the two resistors in series. (4 marks)
4. An object of mass 2 kg moving at 6 m/s collides and stops in 0.4 s. Find the force exerted. (4 marks)
5. State two differences between transverse and longitudinal waves. (2 marks)
6. Calculate the pressure exerted by a force of 500 N on an area of 0.25 m^2. (3 marks)
7. Define the term 'work' and state its SI unit. (2 marks)
